company.name: GK Nexergy

company.about: GK Nexergy is a technology, skill development, and software solutions company. We bring technology, learning, industry, and opportunity together through one connected ecosystem. We empower local talent, build dependable software and digital solutions for businesses, and help organisations transform through AI, data, cloud, and automation.

pillars.description: Industry-grade workforce empowerment through Nexergy Academy.
Custom enterprise software, mobile applications, and digital platforms.
Modernizing businesses with AI, cloud, workflow automation, and analytics.

company.vision: A connected ecosystem where quality technology education, innovation and real-world experience create opportunity — for individuals, for businesses and for the wider digital economy.
company.mission: To train people with industry-relevant technology skills, build dependable software and digital solutions for businesses, and help organisations transform through the right use of AI, data, cloud and automation — connecting people, technology and business to create lasting opportunity for communities.
values: Business-first approach (start with the business problem, then choose technology)
Honest, practical delivery with real outcomes
Empowering local, rural, and semi-urban communities with quality tech education

academy_courses.title: Foundation Program (Python, PostgreSQL, Cloud & AI)
academy_courses.subtitle: Python • PostgreSQL • Cloud • AI
academy_courses.description: A structured learning journey across the core technologies of modern software — Python, PostgreSQL, AWS / Azure and AI Fundamentals — designed to take learners from basics to industry readiness.
curriculum_highlights: Python programming fundamentals to advanced object-oriented design
Relational database design, SQL querying and PostgreSQL
Cloud fundamentals with AWS / Azure and workload deployment
Modern AI fundamentals, tools, and real-world application
Hands-on capstone project mirroring production standards
academy_courses.target_audience: Students, fresh graduates, career returnees, and anyone starting a serious technology journey.

academy_courses.title: Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking
academy_courses.subtitle: Ethical Hacking & Defensive Security
academy_courses.tagline: Learn to Think Like an Attacker. Defend Like a Professional.
academy_courses.description: A practical cyber security program covering security fundamentals and ethical hacking — built around hands-on labs, real attack surfaces and defensive thinking.
curriculum_highlights: Networking fundamentals and security protocols
Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT)
Web application security & OWASP Top 10
Defensive security architectures and incident response
Hands-on lab environments with real-world scenarios
academy_courses.target_audience: Aspiring security analysts, ethical hackers, network administrators, and developers wanting deep security expertise.

academy_courses.title: Databases In-Depth (SQL & PostgreSQL)
academy_courses.subtitle: SQL & PostgreSQL
academy_courses.tagline: Master the Layer Every Application Depends On.
academy_courses.description: A deep, practical program on databases — from fundamentals and SQL to PostgreSQL, data modelling and the querying skills real software teams expect.
curriculum_highlights: Database normalization and relational schema architecture
Advanced SQL queries, window functions, CTEs and aggregations
Indexing strategies, query optimization, and execution plans
Transactions, ACID compliance, and concurrency control
PostgreSQL administration, backup, and performance tuning
academy_courses.target_audience: Backend developers, data analysts, engineering students, and software engineers seeking database mastery.

academy_courses.title: AI Tools & Digital Marketing
academy_courses.subtitle: AI-Assisted Growth Strategy
academy_courses.tagline: Market Smarter With AI at Your Side.
academy_courses.description: A practical program on using modern AI tools across digital marketing — from AI-assisted content and productivity to digital growth strategy and real campaign applications.
curriculum_highlights: Digital marketing fundamentals & search marketing
AI-assisted copywriting, visual assets, and content creation
Social media automation and audience segmentation with AI
Campaign performance analytics and growth experiments
Responsible, ethical use of AI tools in marketing workflows
academy_courses.target_audience: Students, marketing professionals, entrepreneurs, and business owners looking to leverage AI in marketing.
